Remove pages

Delete unwanted pages in one clean pass.

Select pages by range or click thumbnails, then remove them from the document. Everything else keeps its original quality, text and links.

Processed entirely in your browser. Your file is not uploaded, stored or retained by Paperly.

How Remove pages works

  1. Add the PDF and see its pages.
  2. Select the pages to delete, by range or thumbnail.
  3. Remove and download the shortened document.

Limitations

Results depend on the input document. Always keep the original file until you have verified the output.

Related tools

  • Extract pages — Pull out exactly the pages you need.
  • Organize PDF — Reorder, rotate and remove pages visually.
  • Split PDF — Break one document into the exact pages you need.
